title: Boiling Down Uncertainty: Deep Generative Scenario Search with Decision-Guided Evolution Strategies for Two-Stage Stochastic Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.32573v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: One of the most common models for handling uncertainty is two-stage stochastic programming. Choosing the right number of scenarios is a trade-off between the uncertainty that can be represented and computational cost. A recent method, Deep Generative Scenario Search, generates synthetic scenarios and improves them by learning from the decisions they induce. The original approach used a black-box gradient estimate, since decisions are piecewise constant across scenarios. This paper provides the missing analytical foundation by deriving the gradient in closed form from recourse duality and an adjoint solve of the regularized reduced problem. The decision-focused direction, with a heuristic direction as a backup when duals are unavailable, defines the sampling subspace of a guided evolution strategy rather than being used as a direct update. translated_title: 蒸炼不确定性：面向两阶段随机优化的决策引导进化策略深度生成式情景搜索
translated_abstract: 两阶段随机规划是处理不确定性最常用的模型之一。选择合适的情景数量需要在可表征的不确定性与计算成本之间进行权衡。近期提出的一种方法——深度生成式情景搜索，通过生成合成情景，并从这些情景所诱导的决策中学习来改进情景质量。由于决策在情景之间是分段常数的，原始方法不得不使用黑盒梯度估计。本文通过借助补偿对偶性和正则化简化问题的伴随求解，推导出闭式形式的梯度，补齐了该方法缺失的解析理论基础。决策聚焦方向（当对偶变量不可用时以启发式方向作为后备）被用作引导进化策略的采样子空间，而非直接作为更新方向。对于任意引导子空间，期望更新都是平滑目标的下降方向，因此……
tldr: 本文通过补偿对偶性与伴随求解推导出闭式梯度，为深度生成式情景搜索补齐了解析理论基础，并将决策聚焦方向作为引导进化策略的采样子空间，保证期望更新为平滑目标的下降方向，从而改进两阶段随机优化的情景生成。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the missing analytical foundation for Deep Generative Scenario Search by deriving a closed-form gradient via recourse duality and an adjoint solve, using the decision-focused direction as the sampling subspace of a guided evolution strategy so that the expected update is guaranteed to be a descent direction of the smoothed objective for two-stage stochastic optimization.
